postconditions.description: If searchText is empty, the output must be 0; otherwise, the output must be a non-negative integer.

postconditions.expression: stdout == sum(1 for i in range(len(fullText) - len(searchText) + 1) if fullText[i:i+len(searchText)] == searchText)
postconditions.description: The output must equal the number of non-overlapping occurrences of searchText in fullText.

postconditions.expression: stdout == sum(1 for i in range(len(fullText) - len(searchText) + 1) if fullText[i:i+len(searchText)] == searchText and (i == 0 or not allowOverlap or fullText[i-1] != searchText[0]))
postconditions.description: The output must equal the number of occurrences of searchText in fullText, considering overlap based on allowOverlap.
